observations.note: Calculated from complete official HKMA Daily Monetary Statistics, with business-day coverage checked against the Hong Kong government holiday calendar. This is not yet the published HKMA monthly average; the official monthly release replaces it when available.
observations.calculation_basis: Arithmetic mean of all published HKAB 1-month daily fixings on Hong Kong business days in the completed calendar month; no forward filling.

observations.scope: HSBC Hong Kong dollar best lending rate
observations.source_table: HKD best lending rate effective-date history
observations.source_field: Effective Date / HSBC Hong Kong Dollar Best Lending Rate
observations.freshness_basis: Fresh HSBC effective-date history covers the completed calendar month
observations.note: Calculated from HSBC published effective rates, weighted across all 31 calendar days including weekends and holidays; the new rate applies on its effective date (31 days at 5.00%). This is a calculated monthly average, not an HKMA-published monthly figure. Effective dates are not publication dates; no monthly publication date is inferred. Published HKMA monthly values take precedence when available.
